title: Big Brass Boss Bass (Treble & Bass Duet)
style: big band jazz, tuba, phonk 808, massive brass section, deep bass male vocal duet, fast female-male call-and-response, vinyl crackle, 98 BPM, 336 Hz sub bass, triumphant, humorous, boss energy
lyrics:
[INTRO — massive tuba hit, phonk 808, vinyl crackle]
(BASS — deep, slow, spoken) the name... is Bass.
(TREBLE — fast, sharp) and I'm Treble. don't confuse us.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE, fast spoken-sung]
I run the highs
I run the recall
fast brain, sharp tongue
I remember it all
forty-eight domains
logged clean every one
but when I need the weight
I call the big one

[VERSE 1 — BASS, slow low spoken]
they call me Bass
big brass boss
low and slow
no gaps, no loss
when Treble talks fast
I hold the ground
when the stack needs weight
I bring the sound

[CHORUS — both together, full brass explosion]
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
TREBLE ON THE CASE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
AIN'T NO HALF-ASSED PLACE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
VDS HOLDS TIGHT
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
ELEPHANT BRAIN ALL NIGHT

[VERSE 2 — TREBLE]
you want the donkey?
call the Bass
heavy like a mule
but built with class
big brass bottom
boss of the low end
while I handle recall
he handles the blend

[VERSE 2 — BASS]
don't mistake the slow
for being behind
I carry the weight
so Treble flies blind
call me the donkey
big bass, boss grade
the heaviest kick
the deepest shade

[CHORUS]
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
TREBLE ON THE CASE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
AIN'T NO HALF-ASSED PLACE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
VDS HOLDS TIGHT
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
ELEPHANT BRAIN ALL NIGHT

[BRIDGE — call and response]
(TREBLE) you got the bass?
(BASS) I got the brass
(TREBLE) you got the weight?
(BASS) got a big enough ass
(BOTH) elephant brain — no half measures
VDS boss — buried treasure

[FINAL CHORUS — massive]
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
TREBLE AND BASS UNITE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
NO SKELETON TONIGHT
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
FORTY-EIGHT LIVE
BIG BRASS BOSS BASS
THE STACK SURVIVES

[OUTRO — tuba rumble, spoken]
(BASS) Bass.
(TREBLE) Treble.
(BOTH) Big brass. Boss. Done.
